newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cashes bond on sugar supply default.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cashes bond on sugar supply default.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan has cashed in a 17 million rupees five percent performance bond for a firm's non-supply of 25,000 tonnes of sugar, a TCP official said on Monday.

The official did not give the name of the firm at fault but one private dealer said a Turkey-based firm had failed to supply 25,000 tonnes of Brazilian sugar at $383 per tonne C&F Karachi by August 31 according to the terms of an agreement between the firm and the TCP.
TCP bought 50,000 tonnes of sugar from India, the official said.
